phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and a radio communication module, designed for wireless soil moisture measurement in precision agriculture.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification captures the industry-standard form of capacitive soil moisture sensors used in agricultural IoT applications where the sensor probe measures soil moisture capacitively, the MCU processes the sensor data, and the radio module enables wireless data transmission. This combined assembly represents the most common commercially available system for automated field monitoring in 2024.
